G7b_transfer_field_convergence.note: worst interior relative change between the core and fine transfer fields (source radius, azimuth, retarded delay, redshift), boundary rays excluded and reported separately. Pixel area is excluded by construction: the profiles use different dx, so it differs by design and is not a convergence failure.

G7b_weighted_operator_discrepancy.note: || C^-1/2 (A_fine - A_core) || / max(1, || C^-1/2 A_fine ||) on the registered 224-dimensional global class, both operators sharing 800 rays per order so only the fields differ

protocol_deviations.effect: No macOS-specific or Apple-Silicon-specific result can be claimed. All float64 CPU numerics are platform-portable and unaffected; runtime and peak-RSS rows describe this Linux host, not a Mac.
